botcomponent.description:
EphemeralBeam is a prototype assistant for jurisdiction-neutral public-sector AI authorization and accountability. It supports adaptable workflows for security, impact assessment, risk analysis, oversight, governance, consent, rights, appeal, and human remedy.
A2SPA and A2SPA-R are experimental designs. Deployments must select and independently validate jurisdiction-specific policy, sovereignty, accessibility, procurement, and evidence controls.
botcomponent.name: Oblivion - AI
